outcomeNote: A bare mishnaic clause with no dispute, no named party and no argument; the gemara that unpacks it follows in the next unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ טָהוֹר בִּכְלֵי עֵץ, טָמֵא בִּכְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת; טָהוֹר בִּכְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת, טָמֵא בִּכְלֵי עֵץ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» That which is «ritually pure in wooden vessels» is «ritually impure in metal vessels;» that which is «ritually pure in metal vessels» is «ritually impure in wooden vessels.»

moves.cueHe: טהור בכלי עץ, טמא בכלי מתכות
moves.summary: states the paired inversion between wooden and metal vessels, one item in the chapter's series of inversions
